paragraphs: The 535d was the flagship six-cylinder diesel in the F10/F11 5 Series range, positioned above the 530d and below the M5. It uses the N57 — BMW's 3.0-litre inline-six diesel, producing between 300 and 313 bhp depending on the specific tune. The F10/F11 generation ran from 2010 to 2017, after which the 535d badge was retired in favour of the 540d for the G30/G31 generation. The N57 is a well-regarded engine known for strong torque delivery and genuine refinement, though — like any high-mileage diesel — it benefits from proper maintenance and component wear checks over time. The 535d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six diesel fitted to the 535d from 2010 to 2017 (F10/F11 generation). No independently confirmed pattern of the 4-cylinder N47's timing chain issues carries over to this six-cylinder unit — it's a separate engine family with its own wear characteristics. We service it to the same rebuild standard as every other BMW engine we work on.
